## Nutrient calculations

This document is for analysing Maroochy River long-term and Yandina and Coolum Creek short term water quality datasets, and for estimating how water quality would change with successional tidal restoration.

### 1. Set up

Load packages.

```{r Load_packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
```

Get data. Note the initial version of Maroochy River gauge data only goes till early 2024 - I am acquiring a newer version at the moment.

Also prepare data. Some data are recorded as the wrong type so change to numeric.

```{r Get_data}
MaroochyWQ <- read_excel(here("Data/WQ_Maroochy_River_HLW_to2024.xlsx"), sheet = "UseMe") %>% 
  mutate(Nox_mgL = as.numeric(Nox_mgL),
         Pheopigments_ugL = as.numeric(Pheopigments_ugL),
         Total_P_mgL = as.numeric(Total_P_mgL))

ChannelWQ <- read_excel(here("Data/BlueHeart_Nov2024_WaterSampleData.xlsx"), sheet = "WaterSampleWithLab_cleanforpape") %>% 
  mutate(Temp_degC = as.numeric(Temp_degC),
         DKP_av = as.numeric(DKP_av),
         Location = substr(Site, 1, 3))

Ch2025WQ <- read_excel(here("Data/Water_quality_drains_2025.xlsx"))
```

### 2. Explore data

Explore data.

Plot NO3 over time at the Maroochy River.

Plot NOx over the tidal cycle at the three locations we surveyed.

(not yet) Plot NOx with distance downstream each channel.

Plot NOx in 2025.

```{r Plot_NO3}
ggplot(MaroochyWQ, aes(x = Survey_date, y = Nox_mgL)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw()

P2 <- ggplot(ChannelWQ %>% dplyr::filter(Location %in% c("Y1.", "M1.", "C1.")), aes(x = Time, y = `NOX-N_av`, group = Location, color = Location)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  #scale_y_log10() +
  ylab("Mean NOx (mg/L)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 18))
P2

ggsave(here("Output/fig/NOx_time.png"), P2, width = 2400, height = 1600, units = "px")

ggplot(Ch2025WQ, aes(x = Date, y = `NOX-N_mgL`, color = Site)) +
  geom_point()
```

Compare between restoration scenarios.

Key dates are:

-   pre-2018: no restoration

-   May 2018: 3a (YCW) restoration

-   \~November 2024: 1A, 1B and 1C restoration

```{r Compare_scenarios}
# make a new column for scenario
MaroochyWQ <- MaroochyWQ %>% 
  mutate(Scenario = case_when(
  Survey_date < as.POSIXct("2018-05-01 00:00:00") ~ "Pre-Restoration",
  Survey_date < as.POSIXct("2024-07-01 00:00:00")  ~ "3A Restoration Only",
  Survey_date > as.POSIXct("2024-10-31 00:00:00") ~ "3A, 1A, 1B and 1C Restoration",
  .default = "Transition"),
  Month = month(Survey_date),
  Month_char = month(Survey_date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)
)
# note the current dataset doesn't go past early 2024 so doesn't have anything after 3A

# plot distribution of values in each scenario
ggplot(MaroochyWQ, aes(x = Scenario, y = Nox_mgL)) +
  geom_boxplot()

# make a model to compare scenarios, while accounting for month
M <- glm(Nox_mgL ~ Month + Scenario, data = MaroochyWQ)
plot(M) # not normal
M2 <- glm(log(Nox_mgL) ~ Month + Scenario, data = MaroochyWQ)
plot(M2) # ok
M3 <- glm(sqrt(Nox_mgL) ~ Month + Scenario, data = MaroochyWQ)
plot(M3) # not amazing but better

summary(M3)

# month is significant, summarise stats for NO3 in each month
NO3_by_month <- MaroochyWQ %>% group_by(Month_char) %>% summarise(mean = mean(Nox_mgL), min = min(Nox_mgL), max = max(Nox_mgL), median = median(Nox_mgL))

# also plot by month
P <- ggplot(MaroochyWQ, aes(x = Month_char, y = Nox_mgL, group = Month)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("Month") +
  ylab("NOx (mg/L)") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 18))
P

ggsave(here("Output/fig/NutByMonth.png"), width = 2400, height = 1600, units = "px", P)
```
